title: PJM Transmission Owners, States Propose Cost Allocation Approaches to FERC

meta.summary:
PJM transmission owners have filed their proposal for allocating the costs of long-term regional transmission planning projects, with a proposal endorsed by the Organization of PJM States Inc. attached. 
 The post  PJM Transmission Owners, States Propose Cost Allocation Approaches to FERC  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
